name: Kunshan GuoLi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Kunshan GuoLi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of electrical vacuum products in China. The company offers vacuum capacitor, HV relay, hydrogen thyratron, magnetron, klystron, power distribution and protection, AC contactor, and vacuum interrupter. Its products are used in new energy vehicles and charging facilities, aerospace and military industry, semiconductor equipment manufacturing, security inspection, irradiation, radar communications, rail transit, coal chemical industry, industrial flaw detection, big science, direct current transmission and distribution, scientific engineering, and other fields. Kunshan GuoLi Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Kunshan, China.
